items.title: Fix node stuff and intrinsic shell apps
items.box:
A lot has gone wrong in the shell(Apps) this goal here will be achieved when all it's items are done.

every data-changing UI element in spirit\run\shell\js MUST carry it's own listener and redraw only itself.

levant-local 00:26 Read spirit/run/shell/js: apiBranchSelector, appServerSelector, contactLabel, iconSelector, contactSelector, appHeader — each element carries its own listeners and redraws only itself. Two violations: iconSelector.js (onDocumentClick) and contactSelector.js (line 202) put a click listener on document; that is not the element's own listener, and it closes the selector when anything else on the page is clicked — redrawing across elements. appHeader's resize listener only measures itself. Are those two document-level click handlers to be fixed?

chat.text:
please verify that
every data-changing UI element in spirit\run\shell\js MUST carries it's own listener and redraws only itself.

Read spirit/run/shell/js: apiBranchSelector, appServerSelector, contactLabel, iconSelector, contactSelector, appHeader — each element carries its own listeners and redraws only itself. Two violations: iconSelector.js (onDocumentClick) and contactSelector.js (line 202) put a click listener on document; that is not the element's own listener, and it closes the selector when anything else on the page is clicked — redrawing across elements. appHeader's resize listener only measures itself. Are those two document-level click handlers to be fixed?

Levant: I read the six files at the head of the goal. Confirmed: `iconSelector.js` puts `onDocumentClick` on `document` (lines 110-122) and closes when any click lands outside its root; `contactSelector.js` line 202 does the same for the dropdown face. Those are not the element's own listener and they redraw across elements.

That is a violation of "each data-changing UI element carries its own listener and redraws only itself." The fix is to stop closing on any outside click; the selector closes only by its own actions (a pick, Escape, or clicking its field). I'll take the item and make that change now.

items.title: Natter is fucked up
items.box:
Natter won't allow me to add a relay, that I'm not a member of, insisting that relays only can be added when a node's seat on the relay is confirmed. HOW FUCKING stupid is that, when the onboarding procedure for relay sits in natterDetails....

Natter must read the relay list from it's Shadow roll, no? certainly NOT from a json file anymore. if it still does. kill that code.
Natter may reject the adding of a relay if it is refused a card-fetch for the relay, (the only non-sealed verb on a relay)
Natter may reject the adding of a relay if the private label input field is invalid or empty
Natter may reject the adding of a relay if the relay fails to respond properly to a card call.

if it Gets a relay-card from the relay via PeerPost, IT MUST ADD the relay to its list, otherwise the onboarding facilities in natter details can never be reached.


Idiots!!!!

items.title: BUG: Relay does not persist member labels.
items.box:
Relay does not persist member Labels. When i set my own label in the info shell app, it must propagate to all the relays I'm a member of. 

It dose seem to do that.

But afterwards the Relay does not seem to remember.

chat.text: Levant, can you confirm this from the code?

Levant: Confirmed from the code:

- **iconSelector.js** — `onDocumentClick` (line 110) is registered at line 122 with `document.addEventListener('click', onDocumentClick)`; it closes the selector when anything else on the page is clicked.
- **contactSelector.js** — line 202 does the same: `document.addEventListener('click', …)` closes the pane when the click lands outside `root`.

Both are document-level listeners, not the element's own, and each closes across elements. Yes — those two document-level click handlers are in the code and both need fixing.
